current_behavior: Planner sometimes invents doc_id before calling knowledge.read_section, causing NOT_FOUND errors.
root_cause: Planner generates a read_section call without a preceding search to ground the doc_id.

alternatives.description: Two-stage planning: search first, then plan read calls
alternatives.tradeoff: Adds one planning step; reduces plan size

alternatives.description: Strict validation: reject any plan with an un-grounded doc_id
alternatives.tradeoff: May reject valid plans; adds a validation step

proposal: Add a system prompt rule: 'Never guess doc_id; read it from a prior knowledge.search result. If you haven't seen the id, don't call read_section.'

expected_metric.method: count doc_id generation failures in 100 runs

replay_plan: Check that all read_section calls use a real id from search
rollback: Revert the prompt change in src/agents/planner.py
